source_title: 4 oak trees felled at Mussoorie estate, forest dept issues challans - The Times of India

We also suspect that trees in the adjoining area are being deliberately dried up,â a resident said, requesting anonymity.Forest guard Abhishek Sajwan told TOI that the resident who felled the trees has been identified. âWe issued a challan for the three trees felled earlier. A challan has also been issued against the alleged violator for the tree cut recently,â Sajwan said.Notably, in 2024, several trees were allegedly felled at the Cliff Cottage estate during an alleged illegal construction of a motor road through an oak forest.
